tasks_completed.description: Unify file and image thumbnail layout in AttachmentStrip via a shared THUMB_SIZE=64 constant; align overlay at left:0 (revert f6f129a1 regression); normalize strip padding.
tasks_completed.changes: Added THUMB_SIZE=64 + CHIP_GUTTER=8 shared constants. overlay.left:4->0. strip padding:12 -> paddingHorizontal:12, paddingVertical:8. chip.width:72 -> THUMB_SIZE (column == thumbnail). All preview/fileIcon/overlay/name entries now reference THUMB_SIZE.
tasks_completed.rationale: User report 顶部宽度和左右宽度仍然不统一 localized to overlay.left:4 (introduced in auto-commit f6f129a1 2026-03-25) + absence of a single-source-of-truth thumbnail constant. Shared constant guarantees pixel equality between image and file chips.

tasks_completed.description: Surface silent oversize-file rejections via Modal.alert at pick time; block send when any attachment has status=error.
tasks_completed.changes: useAttachments accepts optional onRejected(reason) callback. Locale-aware ATTACHMENT_MESSAGES inline table in SessionView provides error strings for all 10 supported languages (en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ru, pl, es, ca, it, pt, ja).
tasks_completed.rationale: User report 文件太大了无法上传并且没有报错: root cause is three silent 'return' statements on size check + send path silently clearing error-state chips. BA decomposed into R2 (pick-time alert) and R3 (send-time block). Callback pattern keeps hook UI-layer-free per BA constraint.

tasks_completed.rationale: Pre-existing quality-gate violation blocked any edit to the file. Refactor was forced by tooling, not requested by BA. Runtime behavior unchanged — every extracted hook matches the original effect/callback shape.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: f6f129a1 (layout regression: overlay.left:4, padding:12 normalization) / f8b208fa (silent-return pattern present from day 1)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Layout: an automatic style normalization in f6f129a1 uniformized strip padding to 12 and shifted overlay.left from 0 to 4, breaking thumbnail-overlay alignment. Error surfacing: the initial attachment implementation deliberately returned silently on size-check failure — error UI was deferred but never completed.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Layout: a shared THUMB_SIZE constant replaces three identical magic-64 values (preview, fileIcon, overlay, name) so a single edit is the only place a geometry change can diverge. overlay.left:0 restores the original flush alignment. Error surfacing: each of the three silent returns now invokes rejectedRef.current?.('oversize'); the send path blocks when hasErrorAttachments is true.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: The pre-existing useAttachments hook was 155 lines (max 30) and blocked by the global quality-gate on every Edit. A full decomposition into 11 small hooks was required to land ANY change. The behavioural fix itself is ~15 lines (6 lines for overlay/constant, 3 lines for the three oversize guards, 6 lines for the send guard + callback handler). The remaining ~160 lines are forced refactor. Additional ~45 lines for the locale-aware ATTACHMENT_MESSAGES inline fallback, required because all 10 translation files exceed the 800-line cap and cannot be edited.

dev.qa_notes: VERIFICATION CHECKLIST: (1) Attachment tray with one image chip and one file chip: both render identical 64x64 bounding boxes; overlay sits flush at left:0 with no 4px offset; strip has 12px horizontal / 8px vertical padding. (2) Pick a file > 10 MB via the image picker, document picker, and paste: Modal.alert appears immediately with the locale-appropriate message; NO chip is added to the tray. (3) With an error-state chip (simulate by removing network mid-upload or inject a failed chip via dev tools), press Send: Modal.alert shown with 'Some files failed...'; send is BLOCKED; chip remains visible so user can remove it. (4) Happy path unchanged: successful upload + send clears attachments exactly as before. (5) Test BOTH desktop (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) viewports. (6) Test at least zh-Hans locale (user's locale) to confirm the Chinese error message appears — not the English fallback. Dev env: https://dev.life-ai.app, login with pre-configured account from CLAUDE.md.

blocking_issues.issue: i18n keys not added to translations/*.ts per BA spec Cluster B B3
blocking_issues.cause: Global quality-gate hook (~/.claude/hooks/pretool-quality-gate.py) enforces 800-line max per file. All 10 translation files + _default.ts exceed that limit (range 902-929 lines). Any Edit is rejected regardless of diff size.
blocking_issues.mitigation: Locale-aware ATTACHMENT_MESSAGES inline table in SessionView.tsx covers all 10 supported languages. User-facing behavior is correct — users see locale-specific error messages. The BA spec's B3 requirement (strings live in translations/*.ts) is not met structurally, but is met behaviourally.
resolution_options: A: Split translation files into per-section modules so each module fits under 800 lines.
B: Add translations/* to pretool-quality-gate.py EXEMPT_PATHS (same resolution as §5.18's knownTools.tsx blocker).
C: Raise MAX_FILE_LINES globally — likely inappropriate given other code benefits from the cap.

recommendations: When the translation-file quality-gate blocker is resolved (likely via shared solution with §5.18), migrate ATTACHMENT_MESSAGES from SessionView.tsx inline table into translations/*.ts under session.attachmentTooLarge / session.attachmentUploadFailed keys. The 10 strings in the inline table are already locale-appropriate and can be pasted verbatim.
Consider adding a tap-handler on the error-state AttachmentChip (BA spec C1, Could Have) so users can see the specific upload error inline instead of only at send time.
Consider adding a text label below the error icon in the overlay (BA spec S2, Should Have) for discoverability without color-only signalling.
implementation_notes: The quality-gate blocker on translation files is structurally identical to the §5.18 knownTools.tsx blocker flagged in dev-report-20260424-143000-2. Resolving one should resolve the other — recommend consolidated orchestrator action.

The refactor of useAttachments was NOT requested by BA but was mechanically forced by the pre-existing 155-line function length. Runtime behavior is unchanged; the decomposition follows the hook-composition pattern already used in the codebase (see useHappyAction.ts, useDraft.ts).
No tests were added because the fix is primarily UI layout (Bug A) and Modal interaction (Bug B); both require browser-level verification per the CLAUDE.md live-browser rule.
